records.text: Arizona politicians Eddie and David Farnsworth are brothers and first cousins of Terryl Farnsworth's father, Dwayne Farnsworth.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Terryl (Terryl Farnsworth)'s father is a man named Dwayne Farnsworth. And his first cousins are longtime Arizona congressman Eddie Farnsworth. I believe he left office in 2022. And also his brother, Eddie (Eddie Farnsworth)'s brother is David Farnsworth.

verification.notes: Public biographical sources support that Eddie and David Farnsworth are brothers, but no authoritative public record was found proving the asserted first-cousin relationship to Dwayne Farnsworth.
